name: mobile-entity-heading-narrow
goal: At a phone width the shared entity heading gives its title and summary the available width and puts Details and Conversation below them; desktop and tablet layouts stay as they are.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: At 390px .entity-heading > div has flex: 1 (basis 0), so it keeps only the 95px left beside the two buttons and the summary wraps word by word. Expected: text block full width, both actions below. Unit desktop.style.responsive.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Root's frozen assertions in tests/e2e/ui-remote-phone.spec.ts (sha256 648b3c0d7ed54ba9), test 'a paired phone shows the same workspace through the native adapter': expected summary width >= 318.6, received 94.65625. Root: /tmp/harness-mobile-header-red.log; repeated by me unchanged: /tmp/harness-mobile-header-red-mine.log.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: packages/desktop/src/lib/styles/responsive.css, in the existing @media (max-width: 560px) block: .entity-heading > div { flex-basis: 100% }. Three lines, no markup, test or other file changed.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged file (sha256 648b3c0d7ed54ba9): ui-remote-phone.spec.ts and ui-remote-tablet.spec.ts 7 passed (/tmp/harness-mobile-header-green.log); whole browser suite 38 passed. Heading measured: 390px summary 354 of 354 wide, actions below; 820px and 1440px one row as before.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Desktop checks passed: 354 tests and 38 browser tests. Phone summary now spans the row; actions sit below. Fresh phone/tablet images inspected. Native final captures remain in the parent loop.
